显式性约束：\(\models_{\mathsf{PCTL}}\) 仅由本条目的 DTMC、从状态诱导的路径测度、状态/路径满足关系和语义后承定义；不得把 PCTL* 路径布尔闭包或证明规则隐式加入。

该系统只含 PCTL 状态/路径句法、DTMC 路径测度、概率状态满足和语义后承；不含 PCTL* 路径布尔闭包或证明论对象。

\operatorname{SigmaAlg}(X,\mathcal F)
\Longleftrightarrow
\varnothing\in\mathcal F\land X\in\mathcal F
\land(\forall A\in\mathcal F\ X\setminus A\in\mathcal F)
\land\bigl(\forall A:\mathbb N\to\mathcal F\ \bigcup_{i\in\mathbb N}A(i)\in\mathcal F\bigr).

\sigma_X(\mathcal C)
=\bigcap\{\mathcal F\subseteq\mathcal P(X):
\operatorname{SigmaAlg}(X,\mathcal F)\land\mathcal C\subseteq\mathcal F\}.

\operatorname{ProbMeasure}(X,\mathcal F,m)
\Longleftrightarrow
\operatorname{SigmaAlg}(X,\mathcal F)\land m:\mathcal F\to[0,1]
\land m(\varnothing)=0\land m(X)=1

\qquad\land\ \forall A:\mathbb N\to\mathcal F\,
\bigl[(\forall i<j\ A(i)\cap A(j)=\varnothing)
\Rightarrow m(\bigcup_{i\in\mathbb N}A(i))=\sum_{i\in\mathbb N}m(A(i))\bigr].

\mathsf{Ext}_{\mathcal M,s}
=\{m\in[0,1]^{\mathcal F_s}:
\operatorname{ProbMeasure}(\mathsf{Path}_s,\mathcal F_s,m)
\land\forall n\in\mathbb N\,\forall\bar s\in S^{n+1}\,
(s_0=s\Rightarrow m(\operatorname{Cyl}(s_0,\ldots,s_n))=\prod_{i<n}P(s_i,s_{i+1}))\}.

\begin{aligned}
(r,<,q)\in\mathsf{CmpRel}&\Longleftrightarrow r<q,\\
(r,\le,q)\in\mathsf{CmpRel}&\Longleftrightarrow r\le q,\\
(r,=,q)\in\mathsf{CmpRel}&\Longleftrightarrow r=q,\\
(r,\ge,q)\in\mathsf{CmpRel}&\Longleftrightarrow r\ge q,\\
(r,>,q)\in\mathsf{CmpRel}&\Longleftrightarrow r>q.
\end{aligned}
